objective: Bound large human-review acquisitions with disclosed, deterministic repetition and path controls while preserving every raw scanner finding and reporting every deferred count.

funnel_contract.required_accounting: Publish the retained count and the non-negative delta at every stage. Use deferred or collapsed, never false positive, for candidates omitted from a packet.

identity_contract.text_normalization: Whitespace collapse only; preserve case and punctuation.
identity_contract.path_normalization: Normalize path separators, repeated separators, and leading current-directory segments; preserve case.
identity_contract.breadth_pass: Select at most one representative per family before considering a second.
identity_contract.forbidden_collapse: Do not collapse merely similar mechanisms across different files, locations, or normalized sinks.

path_policy.tier_3_default: deferred from the initial packet but retained and countable
path_policy.override: A caller may request a lower tier explicitly; the plan must record the requested policy.
path_policy.interpretation: Path class prioritizes review effort only and does not predict technical validity or operational actionability.

representative_measurement.interpretation: The retained detailed pre-supplemental report demonstrates substantial exact pre/post repetition, rule-family concentration, and engagement imbalance. These figures select no answer and adjudicate no candidate.

provenance_gap.cause: The final aggregate was recorded after supplemental Semgrep activation, while the retained detailed temporary report contains the earlier 1,331-candidate official-baseline run.
provenance_gap.required_resolution_in_pr_2: Persist the complete raw input reference, digest, funnel counts, and path/family distributions for every production acquisition replay. Do not present the 1,331-candidate measurement as the detailed form of the 1,941-candidate aggregate.

pr_sequence: PR 1 freezes this protocol, pure identity/path primitives, funnel accounting schema, replay tests, and the known provenance gap without changing production acquisition.
PR 2 integrates the contract into review acquisition, persists complete accounting, replays the current bounded evidence, and updates CLI and operator documentation.
promotion_criteria_for_pr_2: Every raw candidate remains in its retained artifact and finding store.
Every funnel stage publishes retained and deferred counts.
Repeated-family selection is capped at two per engagement with a one-per-family breadth pass.
Tier 1 precedes Tier 2; Tier 3 is deferred by default and remains explicitly requestable.
Selection is deterministic under input reordering.
No forbidden identity input affects collapse, capping, balancing, or tie-breaking.
The complete 1,941-candidate input or a fresh equivalent replay is persisted with a digest rather than represented only by an aggregate.
